legal.title: Terms of Service & Privacy Policy
legal.intro: Finset is a SaaS platform dedicated to the financial management of professional football clubs. This page describes our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
legal.contactCta: To exercise your rights or for any question regarding your data, contact us.

sections.title: 1. Service Description
items: Finset is a SaaS platform dedicated to the financial management of professional football clubs.
Access is provided through a web application with role-based access control (RBAC).

sections.title: 2. Data Hosting & Infrastructure
items: The application is hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS).

Multi-tenant architecture with two levels of isolation: one dedicated RDS PostgreSQL instance per country (data localized by country), and within each instance, one isolated PostgreSQL schema per club (the primary cross-club data isolation mechanism).
Data is stored in the country of residence of the club (data sovereignty). For example, a French club's data is stored in the AWS region configured for France (e.g. eu-west-3 / Paris).
Currently, only the French (FR) datasource is configured; additional country instances are part of the target architecture and will be added as Finset expands.
AWS acts as a sub-processor subject to GDPR Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs).

sections.title: 3. Use of Artificial Intelligence
items: Finset uses the Anthropic Claude API for AI-powered extraction of player and contract data from uploaded PDF files.

Cross-border transfer notice: when a PDF is processed, its content (which may contain personal data) is transmitted to the Anthropic API (US-based infrastructure) for the duration of the extraction. This is a temporary transfer outside the club's country of residence and constitutes an exception to the data-localization principle described in section 2. It is covered by Anthropic's DPA and EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
Data sent to Anthropic is used solely for extraction purposes and is never used to train AI models.
API logs are retained by Anthropic for a maximum of 7 days before automatic deletion.
Anthropic is a sub-processor covered by a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) incorporating EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
Users must be informed before uploading any PDF containing personal data.

sections.title: 4. Data Controller & Sub-processors
items: Finset acts as a data processor on behalf of the club, which is the data controller.
AWS — infrastructure and database hosting.
Anthropic PBC — AI processing for the PDF import feature.
Auth0 (Okta) — identity & authentication provider (user accounts are managed in Auth0, not in the Finset database).

sections.title: 5. Personal Data Processed
items: Player identity data (name, date of birth, nationality).
Contract data (salary, bonuses, contract duration, clauses).
User account data (club administrators and staff) — managed by Auth0.
Usage logs for security and audit purposes.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights (GDPR)
items: Right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection.
Response time: within 30 days as required by GDPR.

sections.title: 7. Data Retention
items: Active contract data: retained for the duration of the subscription plus the legal archiving period.
Deleted data: purged within 30 days of a deletion request or account termination.
Anthropic API logs: 7 days maximum (managed by Anthropic).

sections.title: 8. Security
items: Data encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+).
Role-based access control within the platform.
Regular security audits.

sections.title: 9. Subscription & Billing Terms
items: SaaS subscription model (monthly or annual).
Pricing based on the number of clubs / users.
Cancellation and refund conditions to be defined with the legal and business teams.

sections.title: 10. Limitation of Liability
items: Finset is not liable for data entered incorrectly by users.
Availability SLA to be defined.

sections.title: 11. Governing Law
items: To be defined based on the company's country of incorporation (placeholder: French law / GDPR).

sections.title: 12. Updates to this Policy
items: Users are notified by email of any material changes.
Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the changes.
